M19.8.1.sentence: An agent can operate an allowlisted desktop application inside an isolated virtual desktop, with every action recorded, every write held for a person's approval, and no route to any other application or network

M19.9.1.sentence: A browser action outside its approved envelope suspends the run and sends a new approval naming the breach, and actions inside the envelope never ask again

M19.9.10.sentence: On the install an agent's browser write to an allowlisted site is compiled into an envelope, approved by a person, signs in with a vaulted credential that never appears in the plan, trace or recording, and performs exactly the approved writes

M19.9.11.sentence: Browser session recordings on the install are written to the object store at run end, and a scheduled job removes expired ones, keeps held ones and reports undated objects

M19.9.2.sentence: Browser approval is proved on an install: a read-only website check runs without approval, a planned browser write is shown once as a readable diff of its envelope and approved, steps inside the envelope are not asked again, and a step outside it suspends the run and asks again, with the checks recorded

M19.9.3.sentence: A browser run starts from an empty profile in its own container and cannot attach to or import a staff member's browser profile, cookies or session, asserted by a test

M19.9.4.sentence: Website and portal reading is proved on an install: asked whether a live website is working, an agent checks it over HTTP, opens the rendered page in the read-only browser from an empty sandboxed profile with egress limited to that origin, and cites what it observed; and a read-only browser task logs in to a portal with no API using a vault credential the model never sees and returns the figure asked for; the session recording is kept under its retention class and the checks are recorded

M19.9.5.sentence: A browser write is proved on an install: one multi-step form-filling task against a registered target runs at the Assisted rung only after its plan is approved, a step outside the approved plan is refused, and the task is reported done only after an independent read-back from the target system, with the checks recorded

M19.9.6.sentence: The browser sandbox runs on an install, and an agent whose ceiling holds the browser tools opens a page in it.

M19.9.7.sentence: An administrator grants a per-surface browser write exception or a browser-over-API exemption from the console with an approver and expiry, it is recorded in the audit ledger as a leash change, listed until it lapses, and a run compiled after expiry no longer has it

M19.9.8.sentence: On the install a browser run's outcome is scored by a judge from its actions and admitted frames against the rubric fixed before the run, and a declared target's result is read back from its system of record before the run is reported done

M19.9.9.sentence: On the install open browser sessions are counted as they start and end, and a session over the global, per-website or per-agent limit waits or is refused with a sentence naming the limit
